name: beeflsp
description: Beef language support (completion) powered by the Beef compiler frontend

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension launches the beeflsp executable from the workspace.

platform.description: Platform to build (Win64, Linux64, ...). Defaults to the workspace's first platform.

project.description: Project to launch. Defaults to the workspace's startup project.

config.description: Build configuration (Debug, Release, ...). Defaults to the workspace's first configuration.

platform.description: Platform (Win64, Linux64, ...). Defaults to the workspace's first platform.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

cwd.description: Working directory of the program. Defaults to the directory of the binary.

buildBeforeLaunch.description: Run the matching BeefBuild task before launching.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program entry point instead of running to the first breakpoint.

configurationSnippets.label: Beef: Launch the startup project
configurationSnippets.description: Build and debug the workspace's startup project.

configurationSnippets.label: Beef: Launch a configuration and platform
configurationSnippets.description: Build and debug a specific configuration and platform.

beef.server.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `beeflsp` executable. When empty the extension looks for `beeflsp(.exe)` in `<workspace>/build-lsp/bin`, `<workspace>/build/bin`, `<workspace>/BeefLSP/build/bin`, `<workspace>/IDE/dist`, and finally on `PATH`.

beef.server.extraArgs.description: Extra command line arguments passed to beeflsp.

beef.server.diagnosticsDelayMs.markdownDescription: How long the document has to be idle before errors and warnings are recomputed. Lower values feel snappier but re-resolve more often; incremental resolves take roughly 100-250 ms.

beef.buildTool.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `BeefBuild`/`BeefBuild.exe`. Takes precedence over `#beef.sdk.path#`.

beef.sdk.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Beef SDK (the installation folder that contains `IDE/dist/BeefBuild` and `BeefLibs/corlib`). When empty, the SDK is discovered next to the workspace, from the workspace's `corlib` path, or on `PATH`.
